title: 13 Woodstown Heights, Knocklyon, Dublin 16, Co. Dublin, D16AX22
description:
Presented in excellent condition throughout, the property enjoys a notably private, directly south-facing rear garden offering all-day sunshine and provides exceptional scope for future expansion, including a rear extension and attic conversion, with strong precedent established throughout the development (subject to planning permission). Further features include a B-rated BER, gas-fired central heating and bright, well-balanced accommodation designed for modern family living. Combining excellent presentation, future potential and a highly convenient location, No. 13 represents an outstanding opportunity for purchasers seeking a turnkey home with exceptional long-term potential.

Upon entering, a bright and welcoming entrance hallway sets the tone for the well-presented accommodation that follows. To the front, the spacious living room enjoys a charming bay window and feature fireplace, creating a warm and inviting setting. Double doors lead through to the open-plan kitchen and dining area, a bright and airy space overlooking the sunny south-facing rear garden. The kitchen is fitted with an extensive range of wall and floor units, offering excellent storage and workspace, while direct garden access makes it ideal for both everyday family living and entertaining.

Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, all benefiting from fitted wardrobes, including a generous principal bedroom with its own en-suite bathroom. A well-appointed family bathroom serves the remaining accommodation. Thoughtfully laid out and exceptionally well maintained, the property is ideally suited to the needs of modern family living.

Woodstown Heights is a highly regarded and well-established residential development, ideally positioned at the foothills of the Dublin Mountains. The location offers an exceptional balance of convenience and outdoor living, with a wide range of amenities close by, including Woodstown and Knocklyon Shopping Centres, Lidl Ballycullen and the recently opened Tesco at White Pines. For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, Knocklyon Football Club and Ballyboden St. Enda`s GAA Club are nearby, while the Dublin Mountains, St. Enda`s Park and Marlay Park provide excellent opportunities for recreation and scenic walks.

The area is particularly well served by public transport, with the 24-hour No. 15 bus route and additional services including the 15B, S8 and 65B all within easy walking distance. Families are spoiled for choice when it comes to education, with an excellent selection of highly regarded primary and secondary schools nearby, including St. Colmcille`s, Firhouse Educate Together, Gaelscoil Chnoc Liamhna, Sancta Maria College, Coláiste Éanna, Terenure College and Loreto Beaufort. Combining a peaceful residential setting with outstanding local amenities and connectivity, Woodstown Heights continues to be one of the most sought-after addresses in the area.

Entrance Hall (1.78m x 3.75m)
Bright and welcoming entrance hall featuring attractive oak-effect flooring and a convenient guest WC. Includes a security alarm panel and carpeted staircase leading to the first floor. dark oak-effect flooring throughout.

Living Room (3.33m x 5.87m)
A bright and generously proportioned front-facing reception room, enhanced by a large bay window with fitted blinds and an attractive fireplace with inset electric fire. Double doors open to the dining room and kitchen beyond, while dark oak-effect flooring flows throughout, creating a cohesive and inviting space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.

Dining Room (2.44m x 3.64m)
open-plan dining area with recessed lighting, a central island and attractive dark oak-effect flooring throughout. Open to the kitchen and accessed via double doors from the living room.

Kitchen (2.77m x 3.64m)
A well-appointed kitchen featuring an excellent range of floor and eye-level units, tiled flooring and generous worktop space. Appliances include a Zanussi oven, hob and extractor fan, together with an Indesit dishwasher, while a rear door provides direct access to the garden. The gas-fired boiler is also housed here.

Guest WC (0.75m x 1.87m
Comprising WC and wash hand basin and tiled flooring.

Landing
Carpeted stairs lead to a bright landing area finished with high-quality dark oak-effect flooring. A window provides natural light, while the landing offers access to all three bedrooms, the family bathroom, hot press, and attic hatch.

Primary Bedroom (3.10m x 4.55m)
Generous double bedroom enjoying a bright and airy feel, overlooking the rear of the property. The room features extensive fitted wardrobes providing excellent storage and attractive dark oak-effect flooring throughout.

En-Suite (2.01m x 1.87m)
Contemporary en-suite bathroom, fully tiled and presented in excellent condition. Comprising a WC, wash hand basin with vanity unit, and walk-in shower with glazed screen and rainfall shower fitting. Stylish monochrome floor tiling is complemented by crisp wall tiling, creating a bright and modern finish. The room also benefits from a wall-mounted mirror and natural ventilation.

Bedroom 2 (2.99m x 4.36m)
Generous front-facing bedroom with fitted wardrobes and attractive light grey oak-effect flooring. Well-presented throughout and flooded with natural light, the room is ideally suited as a children`s bedroom, guest room, or home office.


Bedroom 3 (2.32m x 2.75m)
Front-facing single bedroom featuring fitted wardrobes and attractive light grey oak-effect flooring. A bright and versatile room, ideal as a child`s bedroom, nursery, study, or home office.


Family Bathroom (2.01m x 1.75m)
Contemporary family bathroom comprising a full-sized bath with shower attachment, WC, and wash hand basin. Finished with attractive large-format tiling and complemented by a chrome heated towel rail, mirrored wall cabinet, and frosted window providing natural light and ventilation.


To Front:
A paved driveway provides off-street parking for two cars, while mature planting enhances the property`s welcoming kerb appeal. A gated side entrance offers convenient access to the rear garden. Enjoying a quiet position towards the end of the cul-de-sac, the property benefits from a peaceful and highly desirable setting. Open green area nearby.

To the Rear:
A directly south-facing private rear garden, beautifully maintained and thoughtfully landscaped with patio, gravelled and lawned areas. Enjoying excellent privacy, the garden is bordered by mature planting and benefits from a garden shed and convenient side entrance access. An ideal space for outdoor dining, entertaining and family enjoyment.

title: 15 Bessborough Parade, Dublin 6, Rathmines, Dublin 6, D06XY32
description:
Mullery O’Gara are delighted to present to the market 15 Bessborough Parade. An attractive four-bedroom Victorian, brick-fronted family home. Superbly positioned at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac off Mountpleasant Avenue and within easy walking distance of Ranelagh, Rathmines and the city centre.

Beautifully cared for and thoughtfully enhanced by its current owners, offering light-filled, deceptively spacious accommodation and combines a wealth of period detail with well-considered modern improvements. Ideally situated in the heart of Dublin 6, it is within easy walking distance of Ranelagh, Rathmines and Dublin city centre.

The accommodation is exceptionally well laid out with a wonderful sense of flow between the interconnected reception rooms on the ground floor and a wonderful connection with the garden beyond. A welcoming entrance hallway features a period-style porcelain chequered tiled floor, fanlight, ceiling cornice, centre rose and archway leading to the inner hall. There is a guest WC and useful understairs storage. 

To the front the living room retains a wealth of original features including timber shutters, ceiling coving, picture rail and an open fireplace with cast-iron surround and marble mantelpiece. The adjoining lounge is equally inviting with ceiling coving, bespoke alcove cabinetry and a sealed solid fuel stove within a marble fireplace. Double glazed doors lead through to the impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area, creating a wonderful space for both everyday living and entertaining.

The recently renovated kitchen is complete with an extensive range of Shaker-style units, Belfast sink, extractor, plumbed for dishwasher, quartz worktops, upstands and splashback. The dining area is particularly impressive with large double doors opening directly onto the rear garden and a glazed apex roof overhead bathing the space in natural light. 

The first floor return accommodates the hot press, family bathroom and one of the four bedrooms. The bathroom is finished with a bath and dual shower attachment, recessed shelving, WC, whb and tiled walls. 

On the first floor, there are three further bedrooms. The principal bedroom is positioned to the front and features a beech timber floor, shutters, fitted wardrobes with ensuite shower room. There are two further bedrooms are positioned to the front and rear respectively both benefiting from sash windows and original-style shutters.

Outside the property has a railed front garden. To the rear is a wonderfully private, low-maintenance split-level garden laid in paving and offering an excellent space for outdoor dining and entertaining. A substantial garage to the rear provides valuable additional storage and is plumbed for a washing machine. There is rear access onto Fortescue Lane with pedestrian, cyclist and vehicular access, while residents also benefit from on-street parking and pedestrian access to Rathmines Church car park.

The convenience of Bessborough Parade cannot be overstated. Set in the heart of Dublin 6, the property is within minutes of the vibrant villages of Ranelagh and Rathmines, renowned for their excellent selection of boutiques, independent shops, cafés, bars and restaurants. Dublin city centre and the Grand Canal are also within comfortable walking distance. The area is exceptionally well served by a superb choice of primary and secondary schools, including Ranelagh Multi-Denominational School, Scoil Bhríde, Kildare Place, Sandford Park, St. Mary’s, Alexandra College, Muckross Park and Gonzaga College. The LUAS and numerous bus routes are close by, providing swift and convenient access to the city centre and beyond.

For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, there is an excellent selection of gyms, yoga studios and recreational amenities nearby, while some of Dublin 6’s most attractive green spaces, including Belgrave Square, Ranelagh Gardens, Dartmouth Square and Palmerston Park, are all within easy reach.
